title: feat(types,layout,app-shell): a navigation entry with no label renders its target's current label at render time (objectui#9868)
body:
Fixes #9868
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

Executes ruling letter A on the card (comment 5731297631, the cloud#2021 ruling; spec half landed as `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0, which `main` resolves since PR objectui#11086). A navigation entry with NO `label` now shows the CURRENT label of what it opens, resolved at render time; a present label renders verbatim. Nothing is stored, no sentinel, no `inherited` flag, no new metadata member.

- **`@object-ui/types`** (widening, `minor`): `NavigationEntryItem.label` is optional. The zod mirror's superRefine (the `for (const key of ['id', 'label'] as const)` loop) now requires `id` only; a label-less entry of every entry type passes and parses with NO `label` key (nothing filled in at parse time). An EMPTY label stays refused, now with a message that says to omit the key (the spec's base accepts `''`; this is a stated divergence, kept from before). `menuItemToNavigationItem` stops writing `label: ''` for a legacy item with no label.
- **`@object-ui/layout`**: `resolveNavItemLabel` gains an absent arm, reached before `resolveLabel` (which would read `label.key` off undefined). It asks a new `resolveTargetLabel` resolver (new `NavigationRenderer` prop; exported types `NavLabelTarget` / `NavTargetLabelResolver`) the spec's ladder: the view's label, else the object's / dashboard's label, else the machine name. The arm is keyed on ABSENCE only, so an authored label is never swapped for the target's label, including one spelled like the machine name (route B stays refused). Action entries, the search filter and `AppSchemaRenderer`'s mobile tab bar now go through the same function (all three read `item.label` raw and would throw or mislabel on an absent label).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: new `useNavTargetLabel` hook, wired into both surfaces (`UnifiedSidebar`'s two `NavigationRenderer` mounts and the `nav:menu` block). Navigation sync writes no `label` key for an unnamed page or dashboard (it used to write `label || pageName` / `label || dashboardName`); an author label is still written; stored labels are untouched. The toast text keeps its display fallback.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/guide/designing-app-navigation.md` said `label` is mandatory; it now says what an entry without one shows.

## Premises re-measured on `origin/main` 0ffc423b1 (the order's Zone 2)

- **Spec 17.5.0 accept set, per type** (installed `@objectstack/spec/ui`, `safeParse` with and without `label`): `object`, `dashboard`, `page`, `url`, `report`, `action`, `component`, `doc` and `group` all accept a missing label; the separator still refuses a `label`; the parsed entry carries no `label` key. objectui's type enum has 8 entry types (`doc` is not among them, see Acceptance notes); the mirror now accepts a label-less entry for all 8, pinned per type against the spec in the new test file.
- **Do the shell's resolvers read the target's METADATA label?** No. `useObjectLabel()`'s `objectLabel` / `viewLabel` / `dashboardLabel` only look up the translation bundle and fall back to whatever is passed in, which on the nav path was the nav entry's own label. What does hold the metadata label is the `MetadataProvider` cache: `objects` (the object schema, with the eagerly loaded `view` type merged into `listViews`, keyed `object.key`) and `dashboards`. `useNavTargetLabel` reads those: the view is matched with `resolveViewId` from `@object-ui/core` (the matcher the object page itself uses), an inline locale-map label resolves through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` in the active language, and the result still passes the same bundle lookup, so the nav shows the name the target's own page shows. **No request per nav entry**: `objects` is already read by the sidebar's capability gate; `dashboards` is read only when a dashboard target is asked about (one list for the type, from the cache; the console's `NavigationSyncEffect` loads it anyway).
- **`useNavigationSync`**: the only caller of the add helpers is `NavigationSyncEffect`, and it never passes a label, so every page / dashboard it added was written with its machine name as `label`.
- **The `label: item.label || ''` writers in `packages/types/src/app.ts`**: all three are in `menuItemToNavigationItem`, a RENDER-time conversion of the legacy `menu` key inside `AppSchemaRenderer` (not a stored write; exported publicly though). Changed to omit the key.
- **`tsc` sweep**: with `label` optional, the builds and type-checks found two raw readers outside the claim's list: `AppSchemaRenderer`'s mobile tab bar (`resolveLabel(item.label)`) and `useNavPins` (`label: item.label` into the favorite record, whose `nav` label is a placeholder the sidebar never renders). Both now go through `resolveNavItemLabel`. The first dispatch's `AppSidebar` asymmetry no longer applies: that sidebar was removed (pinned by `appSidebarRemoved-5817`).

## What a label-less entry renders, per type

| entry | text |
|:--|:--|
| `object` naming a view | view label, else object label, else the `viewName` |
| `object` | object label, else `objectName` |
| `dashboard` | dashboard label, else `dashboardName` |
| `page` / `report` | `pageName` / `reportName` (the ruling names inheritance for view, object and dashboard only) |
| `url` / `component` / `action` | the `url` / `componentRef` / `actionDef.actionName` |
| `group`, or an entry missing its target | its `id` |

## Pins (each with its control)

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/nav-label-optional-9868.test.ts`: per type, spec accepts a label-less entry and so does the mirror, with no `label` key after parse; control: a present label (even `'account'`) kept verbatim. `id` still required; `''` refused with the omit-the-key message; separator unchanged; `menuItemToNavigationItem` writes no empty label.
- Inverted, not deleted: `navigation-spec-parity` (label-less entry now accepted, id-less still refused), `navigation-model` (was "should reject missing required label"), `app-wizard-separator-layout-10867` (the type-level control now expects an id-less entry to be the compile error). `zod-lazy-getter-identity-7918`'s nested-superRefine pin keeps its subject with a missing `id` as the trigger plus a positive control.
- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.labelInheritsTarget-9868.test.tsx`: the ladder, the rename (a new resolver answer over the SAME nav tree), the per-type backstops (and the resolver is never asked for them), the controls (explicit label verbatim; explicit machine-name label verbatim and the target resolver not consulted), an unlabelled action entry renders, and search finds an unlabelled entry by the text it shows.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/nav-label-inherits-target-9868.render.test.tsx`: BOTH surfaces (the sidebar's `NavigationRenderer` wired with `useNavTargetLabel`, and `nav:menu`) under one `MetadataCtx`: a view labelled 客户管理仪表盘 renders 客户管理仪表盘; re-rendered with the view renamed, the new name shows on both; object / dashboard inheritance; machine-name backstop; authored labels verbatim.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.navLabelInheritsTarget-9868.test.tsx`: the real `UnifiedSidebar` wiring, rename included.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationSync.labelInherits-9868.test.tsx`: `NavigationSyncEffect` adds a page and a dashboard with no `label` key; control: `syncPageCreated` / `syncDashboardCreated` with an author label store it.

## Ablations (one-shot, not kept), at `444bdb9b5`

Mutations through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, disk-verified, restore armed on EXIT/INT/TERM); tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to `packages/*/src` through the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases, so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and measurement. Every leg went red and every restore proved `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| leg | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | validator re-requires `label` | 13 failed / 26 passed (39); the "still requires an id" pin reddened in the MORE-diagnostics direction (an id-less entry drew an extra `label` issue) |
| A2 | renderer never asks `targetLabel` | 8 failed / 16 passed (24); backstop and control cases stayed green |
| A3 | `UnifiedSidebar` drops `resolveTargetLabel` (both mounts) | 1 failed / 1 passed; control green |
| A4 | `nav:menu` passes no target resolver | 2 failed / 2 passed. A first attempt was REFUSED by the tool (the replacement was a substring of the anchor, so it proved no change) and ran no test; re-run with a distinct replacement |
| A5 | hook ignores the view's metadata label | 2 failed / 4 passed (both surfaces' rename cases) |
| A6 | sync writes `label: label ‖ name` again | 1 failed / 1 passed; author-label control green |

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **One published line this change makes false is NOT edited here**: `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` says every nav item needs an `id` and a `label` ("both required by `NavigationItemSchema`"). `skills/**` is governed, so editing it would turn this PR into one that waits for a maintainer approval, and it is outside the claim's file surface. It needs a one-line skills-only follow-up. Following the stale line still yields valid metadata (a label is still accepted), so nothing breaks meanwhile.
- **Designer surfaces do not show the inherited label** for a label-less entry the runtime now names: the metadata-admin App preview (`normalizeNav` shows `unnamed`), its nav canvas (`navLabel` shows the positional item row), the Studio nav surface (`resolveSurface` reads `String(node.label ?? '')`, so empty text; fenced out here while PR objectui#11179 lands) and `plugin-designer`'s `NavigationDesigner` (`resolveKeyedI18nLabel(item.label)`, so empty text). Reported for the seat, not touched.
- **The pre-existing i18n convention path is unchanged**: a PRESENT label equal to the target's machine name is still offered to the bundle lookup (`isCustomized`), which can translate it when a bundle carries that key. It never reads metadata, it predates the ruling, and retiring it would change what apps with labels materialised by the old sync show. Left as it was; a maintainer question if the spec's "present ⇒ verbatim" is meant to cover translation too.
- **`doc` entries**: the spec's union has a `doc` type; objectui's hand-written type enum does not, so the mirror refuses a spec-valid `{ type: 'doc', book }` entry at `type` (measured on the built dist). Pre-existing and unrelated to the label; objectui#9868 is not where it belongs.
- **Search** now matches the text a row shows (resolvers and `t` included). For a present label this differs from before only when a host passes both `searchQuery` and label resolvers; no current mount does both.

objectui#9868 carries the ruling; cloud#2021 is the cloud half that waits on this PR landing. Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec` (seat `domain:ui#2`, dispatch round 9).
